Unfortunately, I have little information to give you about them other than the rumor that they are secretly backed by the Empire.|[[Pashna Starkiller (Mon Calamari)|Pashna Starkiller]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:PS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Pashna Starkiller"}}</ref>}}
The '''Lord Nyax's Cult hideout''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that served as the headquarters of the religious organization known as the [[Cult of Lord Nyax]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I was a part of the clan myself. They don't like the fact that I left just to cash in on their location by providing others with their whereabouts. Say, would you like to know? Free of charge!|[[Lock Vlash]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Lock Vlash|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lord_Nyax_shrine.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The shrine.]]
The building was the secret hideout of the Followers of Nyax,<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> dangerous fanatics who worshiped the ancient [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ghost (folklore)|ghost]] [[Lord Nyax]] and sought to terrorize the citizens of Corellia.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref><ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> While Lord Nyax was only a mythological character, a man who referred to himself as [[Lord Nyax (cult leader)|Lord Nyax]] was leading the Cult from the hideout. A shrine was located in the courtyard of the hideout, it contained eight skulls and eight [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]],<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> likely those of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] killed by Darth Vader.<ref name="CDAG" />

After he finally managed to escape the Cult, following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the former Follower of Nyax [[Lock Vlash]] intended to earn some money by selling the location of the hideout to any adventurer willing to visit it.<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Pashna Starkiller (Mon Calamari)|Pashna Starkiller]] dispatched a spacer to the Cult of Nyax hideout in order to retrieve an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] dossier with information concerning a particularly ruthless Imperial commander.<ref name="SWG:PS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lord Nyax Cult hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> This location was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
